seo.title: Molecision R8 — automated PCR system Snibe | LabWell
seo.description: Molecision R8 is an automated Snibe PCR system for molecular diagnostics: up to 448 tests in 8 hours and 144 sample positions. Supplied by LabWell in Ukraine.

T2_hero.lead: Combines sample preparation and PCR analysis in a single automated workflow. Nine racks provide capacity for 144 samples.

T3_about.h2: What Molecision R8 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Molecision R8 is a fully automated Snibe PCR system for molecular diagnostics. It combines sample preparation and analysis in one workflow, provides 144 sample positions, and requires less than 2.2 m² of floor space. According to the manufacturer, the first batch of results is available in approximately 113 minutes.

items.text: Sample preparation and PCR analysis are combined within a fully automated system. The laboratory runs both stages as part of one workflow.
Nine racks accommodate 144 samples, helping the laboratory organize loading into the system. The configuration supports throughput of up to 448 tests in 8 hours.
The system requires less than 2.2 m² of laboratory floor space. This provides a clear reference when planning where to install the analyzer.

testMenu.title: Molecular test menu
testMenu.text: The manufacturer’s menu includes assays for sexually transmitted infections and emerging pathogens. Ask LabWell about specific assay names and availability in Ukraine.
